questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {设} \zeta、\eta \text {相互独立，分布律分别为} P\{\zeta = i\} = p(i),\ P\{\eta = j\} = q(j),\ i,j \text {均为正整数．则} \xi = \zeta + \eta \text {的分布律为}() . \end{array}

options.label: A

options.label: B

options.label: C
options.html: \begin{aligned}P\{\xi = k\} = \sum_{i=1}^k \sum_{j=1}^{k-i} p(i) q(j)\end{aligned}

options.label: D
options.html: \begin{aligned}P\{\breve{\zeta}=k\}=\sum_{i=1}^{k}\sum_{j=1}^{k}p(i)q(j)\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{因为独立，所以有} \qquad \qquad P\{\xi=i,\eta=j\} & = P\{\xi=i\} P\{\eta=j\} = p(i)q(j)\,, \\ \text{又}\,\zeta=\xi+\eta,\,\,\,i,j \text{均为正整数，所以} \qquad \qquad P\{\zeta=k\} & = P\{\xi+\eta=k\} = \sum_{i+j-k} P\{\xi=i,\eta=j\} \, = \sum_{i+j-k} p(i)q(j) = \sum_{i=1}^{k} p(i)q(k-i)\,.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{若} \lambda \text{和} Y \text{相互独立，他们分别服从参数为} \lambda_{1}, \lambda_{2} \text{的泊松分布，则} Z = X + Y \text{服从参数为}( )\text{的泊松分布}.

options.label: A

options.label: B

options.html: \lambda _ { 1 } { \cdot } \lambda _ { 2 }

options.html: \sqrt { \lambda _ { 1 } \cdot \lambda _ { 2 } }

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}P\{X=i\}&=\frac{e^{-\lambda_1\lambda_1^i}}{i!}\;(i=0,\,1,\,\cdots)\,;\;P\{Y=j\}=\frac{e^{-\lambda_2\lambda_2^j}}{j!}\;(j=0,\,1,\,\cdots)\\\text{由离散型卷积公式得}\\P\{Z=r\}&=\sum_{i=0}^{r}P\{X=i,\,Y=r-i\}=\sum_{i=0}^{r}e^{-\lambda_1\frac{\lambda_1^i}{i!}}e^{-\lambda_2\frac{\lambda_2^{r-i}}{(r-i)!}}\\&=\frac{e^{-(\lambda_1+\lambda_2)}}{r!}\sum_{i=0}^{r}\frac{r!}{i!(r-i)!}\lambda_1^i\lambda_2^{r-i}=\frac{e^{-(\lambda_1+\lambda_2)}}{r!}(\lambda_1+\lambda_2)^r,\,r=0,\,1,\,\cdots\\\text{即}Z\text{服从参数为}\lambda_1+\lambda_2\text{的泊松分布}.\end{aligned}
